sights.n: Painagama Beach, Hirara (パイナガマビーチ)
sights.w: The closest beach to downtown Hirara, walkable from the port; its name (南長間) means 'long southern beach' in Miyako dialect. A barrier-free city beach popular for sunset and an easy first swim on Miyako.
sights.k: Miyako's walk-in town beach, minutes from Hirara

sights.address: East coast (Higawa side), Yonaguni-chō, Yaeyama-gun, Okinawa, Japan
sights.w: A sheer sea stack rising from the surf off Yonaguni's east coast, revered in island lore as a 'standing god rock'; seen from the roadside viewpoint on the coastal road.
